about: Every module's PLACE: where it sits in the pipeline, whether it carries a compute contract, and what draws it. Declared here; `just places` computes the observed state against it and reports drift. Facts that live elsewhere are NOT copied here: a kernel's reads and writes belong to its ComputeContract, a stage's state to the route, a bar to the spec that declared it. The one field no check can read is `role`, and it is marked as such rather than pretended otherwise: a null role is reported as a count, never as a pass.

where.route:<stage>: runs inside the production route, in that stage of docs/OBJECT_MODEL.md
where.beside: cross-cutting or beside the route, per the object model's 'beside the route'
where.pictures: the drawing layer; a stage is not built until one of these renders it
where.workbench: second tier: probes and systems not yet production
where.script: a project verb, run by hand or by the justfile
where.shelf: exists, is not archived, and has no place in the settled route — a question, not a home

src/knee/pipeline.py.role: the route itself: moves values between stages and decides nothing

src/knee/study/__init__.py.role: docstring only, no code: Figure 8's A MOVIE text, the founder's 2026-10-10 words on the 58, and what the stage hands on

src/knee/study/corpus.py.role: opens the corpus and reads one study whole at stored fidelity

src/knee/study/series.py.role: one series assembled from every .dcm in its directory, reordered along the slice normal, carrying named stack codes; returns a Series on BOTH paths, with volume and geometry None where it cannot stack

src/knee/study/slices.py.role: one DICOM file read whole: the header as stored minus Pixel Data, whose content becomes `pixels` at stored fidelity

src/knee/study/decoders.py.role: the six transfer syntaxes the competition's files need, each reported available or unavailable by name; `require_decoders` raises naming the missing and nothing falls back

src/knee/study/geometry.py.role: slice geometry in the patient's LPS frame from the tags as stored; every reader returns a named status with its values, naming WHICH zero it found (absent, empty, malformed, degenerate) rather than defaulting one

src/knee/study/tables.py.role: the competition's tables read as given, every cell a raw string and a blank kept as a blank, joined into studies with their series and the orphans kept; raises rather than guessing on a header mismatch, a duplicate study or a None cell

src/knee/collapse/__init__.py.role: the field: what a series IS before any expensive work runs

src/knee/collapse/regime.py.role: one series' regime key, read once from its own values and no label

src/knee/collapse/noise.py.role: the noise law, read two independent ways per series

src/knee/collapse/physical.py.role: the physical frame and the squint

src/knee/lenses/__init__.py.role: every place read in every acquisition, in one language

src/knee/lenses/digits.py.role: one place's ternary digit against a static middle

src/knee/objects/__init__.py.role: docstring only, no code: declares the objects stage — what each module in it does, why it was split out of collapse, and that the residual pull-out is still owed

src/knee/objects/analysis.py.role: measures one series through the route: squint, interiors, boundary census

src/knee/objects/interiors.py.role: geometric interiors and observed dark borders, with no anatomical assignment

src/knee/objects/boundaries.py.role: what bounds each territory, and the relief between those that touch

src/knee/objects/conversation.py.role: the same-knee conversation between same-orientation readings

src/knee/objects/profiles.py.role: native profiles cast across a border, reference and JIT twin

src/knee/objects/band_raster.py.role: the convex sample-band supercover: which pixel cells a band touches, ties included, never extrapolated — a reference and its strict JIT twin, returning the mask and an exact visited count

src/knee/objects/border_codes.py.role: the pure named decision for a border reading

src/knee/objects/exchange_codes.py.role: the pure named decision for a boundary exchange

src/knee/objects/profile_codes.py.role: the pure named decision for profile support

src/knee/relations/__init__.py.role: interstices per facing pair, constructed and never detected

src/knee/predicates/__init__.py.role: the twelve findings, each a predicate on its subject

src/knee/output/__init__.py.role: twelve confidences per study, with the kept record behind them

src/knee/vectors/__init__.py.role: every place written in one language; an object's profile is the bundle of its places

src/knee/memory/__init__.py.role: the memory and its buckets; recall arrives at diagnosis, not at the parse

src/knee/agencies/__init__.py.role: the four agencies, each marked where it acts

src/knee/record/__init__.py.role: the kept record of findings, where the agencies meet

src/knee/compute/__init__.py.role: the project-wide compute discipline below every stage: the ComputeContract each kernel carries, and handed_on, which freezes output storage so a consumer cannot write through a reading it was handed; defines nothing itself, re-exports three names

src/knee/telemetry/__init__.py.role: where the compute went and what was recomputed: counted work, not wall time, in plain stdlib because this sits on the production import path and no profiler may reach a Kaggle kernel; off by default, defines nothing itself, re-exports four names

src/knee/telemetry/ledger.py.role: the ledger every stage records its work to

src/knee/pictures/__init__.py.role: the drawing layer, switchable off without the run noticing

src/knee/loop/__init__.py.role: Figure 8's loop; SPINE folds its role into the object model's stages, so it has no stage of its own

src/knee/candidates/__init__.py.role: Figure 8's emptied box and candidates; folds into objects

src/knee/every_object/__init__.py.role: Figure 8's completeness check; folds into ownership

src/knee/assignment/__init__.py.role: Figure 8's recall-routed assignment; belongs to diagnosis, not the parse

workbench/measure/object_analysis.py.role: the real-entry-point analysis run, with its receipt

workbench/measure/machinery_facts.py.role: task 3.8a's run facts: what the object stage produces on one real study

workbench/measure/corpus_shape.py.role: the corpus's view structure from the tables alone, no pixel decode; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/geometry_spread.py.role: per-view geometry spread across the labeled studies, headers only; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/noise_floor.py.role: whether there is imaged air to measure sigma from and whether the intensity law looks Rician, over eight axial fat-suppressed series; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/object_toolkit_geometr.role: native spacing, tile width, superior projection and ordered-stack extent through Chapter 1's reader; WRITES data/measurements/object-toolkit-geometry.json, overwriting it

workbench/measure/regime_key.py.role: laterality, on-disk coverage, signedness and zero share per series, read one file per series; prints, writes nothing

workbench/measure/regime_run.py.role: the regime key over every series of the 58 through the real entry point, the first test of stages 1 and 2 on real data; prints aggregates, writes nothing

workbench/measure/reports.py.role: whether the report column exists, how long it is and whether it is machine-readable — not a reading of its content; prints, writes nothing

workbench/graph/object_measurements.py.role: the development-only Hamilton graph over the production functions

workbench/render/_out.py.role: the one place the workbench's pictures go: `pictures_dir()` resolves data/pictures project-relative from this file and creates it, so a picture lands in the same place from any working directory — and under data/, because a rendered knee is pixels and never enters git

workbench/render/axial.py.role: walks the axial stack through Z to show the space between the two bones, on up to two Axial fluid-sensitive series of at least 12 slices; writes data/pictures/axial.png

workbench/render/look.py.role: looks at four view/weighting combinations — the middle slice as recorded, what knee.collapse.noise's background split calls quiet, the histogram with that split marked, and the squint; writes data/pictures/look.png

workbench/render/objects.py.role: asks whether the femur and tibia are THERE as two bodies with a space where they meet, on both weightings of one Coronal study because the marrow's sign flips between them while cortex is signal-void on both; writes data/pictures/objects.png

workbench/render/object_boundaries.py.role: draws the boundary census: what bounds each territory and the relief between neighbours

workbench/render/object_conversation.py.role: draws the B2 conversation across saved acquired views

workbench/render/object_interiors.py.role: draws the B1 interiors and native traces

workbench/render/object_packet.py.role: renders a source-linked image series from a SAVED Packet A run: per-view panels, series.png and a manifest binding the receipt, the loaded arrays, this renderer and its sibling by digest; writes only under its --out

workbench/render/object_profiles.py.role: draws one saved production measurement record and computes no substitute segmentation — `draw_record` only ARRANGES the saved values and their explicit colour annotations, and does no file I/O; object_packet calls it for both its gallery axis and its per-record figure

workbench/render/seam.py.role: the two objects and the seam between them, with the three corrections its docstring names: the leg CLOSED by filling its holes, the superior-inferior axis read from the header and never assumed to be image rows, and the seam found as a relation between two watershed basins rather than a dark band hunted by intensity; writes data/pictures/seam.png

workbench/render/structure.py.role: air defined by CONNECTIVITY to the frame's edge rather than by a threshold, then whether the joint line survives the squint and where the population of studies disagrees, over three views; writes data/pictures/structure.png

scripts/places.py.role: computes every module's observed place against this file, and reports the drift

scripts/unit_loop.py.role: prints the build loop with the route's live state

scripts/object_graph.py.role: the dependency graph over the production route; a value nothing consumes shows as dangling

scripts/object_status.py.role: recomputes a saved packet's source standing

scripts/detective_resolution.py.role: proves Detective and Wesker resolve to the local checkouts

scripts/verify_profiles_same.py.role: SAME between reference and twin for Packet A

scripts/verify_conversation_visuals.py.role: binds the staged photos to their receipt
